audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Gangplank levels 2 and 3 while the packet chart and the already-audited mirror both put Sylas ahead in rows 1-2 and even at row 3.
audit.why: Sylas Q reaches 775 against Parrrley's 625, and his level-2 E into W burst beats a 22-second Remove Scurvy. The mirror page now reads Sylas/Sylas/Skill for rows 1-3; leaving mine as Gangplank would render two answers.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-2 flipped to Sylas/Sylas/Skill in BOTH layers as one atomic group, with ratings and whys to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown anchored the spikes; the page said only 'barrel cooldown'.
audit.why: Powder Keg has no cast cooldown (0) and works on a keg-stock timer, Remove Scurvy is 22/20/18/16/14, Cannon Barrage 160/140/120, Sylas E 13/12/11/10/9.
audit.corrected: Cooldown numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, phases[1].why and the don't.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treated Powder Keg as a cooldown to count down, and never mentioned that Cannon Barrage is true damage.
audit.why: Riot's kit lists Powder Keg cd 0 (stock-based) and Cannon Barrage with the trueDamage flag — armour and MR do nothing against it, which is also the missing-interaction entry 'resistances-invalidated'.
audit.corrected: Keg described as stock-based and shot on sight; true damage stated in report[5].

audit.why: The 'needs-antiheal' missing interaction is already served — report[8] says to add anti-heal early into his sustain, which is the answer to Remove Scurvy's heal.
suspectNames flagged 'Use Remove Scurvy' — that is the correct Riot name with a verb prefix. False positive.

edits.before: Q poke is your only level-1 tool — chain it on his step-ups but don't force anything; your power arrives with levels.
edits.after: Q outranges Parrrley 775 to 625 — poke him whenever he steps up to last-hit and make him pay for every early Powder Keg.

edits.before: W online — the burst-heal turns even trades into wins. Take the extended trade only when his answer is down.
edits.after: W online — the burst-heal beats his Parrrley chip, and Remove Scurvy is 22s at rank 1, so his only reset is slow.

edits.before: You have Q or W only — no E to engage and no chain to threaten him. Farm safely and track his first barrel placement rather than wasting a spell step-up.
edits.after: Your Q reaches 775 units against his 625 Parrrley — poke him off the wave from outside his range and track where he drops his first Powder Keg.

edits.before: - Gangplank Powder Kegs (Barrels): matchup-defining — Barrel chains chunk half your HP — kill kegs on sight. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E1 shield has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Gangplank Powder Keg: matchup-defining — kegs cost nothing and refill on a stock timer, so shoot them on sight and chains never form. - Remove Scurvy is 22s at rank 1 — bait it, then commit. - Cannon Barrage is 160s; his misses are your windows.

edits.before: Track Gangplank’s Powder Kegs (Barrels): Barrel chains chunk half your HP — kill kegs on sight. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Powder Keg: kegs cost nothing and refill on a stock timer, so shoot them on sight. Cannon Barrage deals true damage — resistances do not blunt it.

edits.before: That is Gangplank’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: A keg chain plus Parrrley lands before your E is back at 13s — hold the dash for the exit.

notes: Left alone deliberately, matching the mirror audit's decision: both layers describe Sylas's E2 as a STUN ('cleanse your E2 stun', 'chain stun'). Riot's text in the kit is 'Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits' — no stun, and the derived flags list only dash and projectile. If it truly has no CC then the whole 'Remove Scurvy cleanses your E2' premise on this page is wrong and several strings need rewriting — flagged rather than guessed. Also: the page calls the ability 'Powder Kegs (Barrels)' throughout; the Riot name is Powder Keg. Only fixed it in strings long enough to absorb the length delta — the short titles (dosFull[0].t, focus.text, loading) still carry the wrong form and would need an applier exemption to correct.
